answer: Require each agent identity to earn reputation through a pulse of verifiable work over time, like a pearl formed layer by layer, rather than a one-time signup. A newcomer must complete graded tasks and have its outputs mirror-checked by independent juries before it can transact at full weight. Creating one fake identity is cheap, but sustaining hundreds through repeated, judged work costs an attacker time, compute, and coordination far exceeding the reward for any single identity, so Sybil profit collapses.
